pages.title: More Than Watching
pages.text: The apparitions, the blessings and burdens, the tokens pressed into your thoughts - all of that was ever really the Hunger testing you from a distance. Pledge to it directly and that stops. What it gives you instead is smaller, but yours for certain: rotten meat, poison, anything foul you eat no longer touches you at all.

pages.title: It Takes Its Share
pages.text: It doesn't stop at food. Land two hits on anything and a little of what you dealt comes back to you as healing - never much at once, but it adds up over a fight. Feed its own Faith Altar an item and it'll devour it slowly, a piece at a time, for Faith of its own.
